description: Source code for LED Manager DML APIs related to TR-181, implementing get and set functions for LED configuration parameters, including decoding base64-encoded data and parsing web config blobs.

methods.name: LedManager_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the 'Data' parameter, returning an empty string.

methods.name: LedManager_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets the value of parameters 'Data' and 'LedFailoverData' by decoding base64 strings and updating internal configuration data.
